lessons: An in-process wire adapter is not an independently hosted remote authority.
HTTP or JSON parse success alone does not prove message integrity or authentication.
Reject duplicate JSON keys and noncanonical signed-body bytes.
A signed witness without an independently pinned fingerprint is replayable after compromise.
Bind witness to authority, store, client, checkpoint, and bounded validity interval.
Never derive an out-of-band trust pin from the same local store being verified.
An authenticated checkpoint is not proof of completed Civil NX analysis or engineering acceptance.
